prompt:
The section file sections/blog-posts-grid.liquid has working markup, but its {% schema %} block is wrong. Several settings are missing or mistyped, some defaults are invalid for their ranges, and editor placement rules are missing. Rewrite only the JSON inside the single {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block. Every byte of the markup above it must stay unchanged.

The schema JSON is graded by parsed equality. Key order inside objects does not matter. Array order does matter. Include no keys other than those listed below.

Top-level keys:
- "name": "Blog posts"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "section-blog-posts"
- "disabled_on": an object whose only key is "groups", with value ["header", "footer"]
- "settings": the array described below
- "presets": exactly one preset, {"name": "Blog posts"}

The settings array must contain exactly these 12 entries, in this order:
1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Blog posts"
2. type "blog", id "blog", label "Blog" (no default)
3. type "range", id "post_limit", min 2, max 12, step 1, label "Number of posts", default 3
4. type "range", id "columns_desktop", min 1, max 4, step 1, label "Columns on desktop", default 3
5. type "header", content "Post card"
6. type "checkbox", id "show_image", label "Show featured image", default true
7. type "select", id "image_ratio", label "Image ratio", default "adapt". Its options, in this order:
   - value "adapt", label "Adapt to image"
   - value "square", label "Square"
   - value "portrait", label "Portrait"
8. type "checkbox", id "show_date", label "Show date", default true
9. type "checkbox", id "show_author", label "Show author", default false
10. type "header", content "Section padding"
11. type "range", id "padding_top", min 0, max 100, step 4, unit "px", label "Top padding", default 36
12. type "range", id "padding_bottom", min 0, max 100, step 4, unit "px", label "Bottom padding", default 36

Numbers and booleans must be JSON numbers and booleans, not strings. The "unit" key appears only on the two padding ranges. Change only sections/blog-posts-grid.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
